verdict.rationale: Snowflake provides strong audit-log coverage via Query History (who ran what queries) and Access History (ACCESS_HISTORY view tracking reads/writes for compliance auditing, including per-column access insights), which addresses the 'who ran what' half of the story well. However, the evidence pack does not document an explicit column-level lineage graph/feature (e.g., Snowflake's Horizon/lineage explorer) showing upstream data provenance — only that Access History surfaces 'popular and frequently accessed tables and columns,' which is usage insight, not full lineage tracing. Missing for 10: explicit column-level lineage/graph documentation, independent validation of lineage accuracy across transformations.
